row: Jefferson Animal Hospital & Regional Emergency Center

Jefferson Animal Hospital & Regional Emergency Center has been established on the Outer Loop in Okolona since 1978 and has been operating 24 HOURS A DAY, 365 DAYS A YEAR since 1980. We continue to be a national leader in veterinary medical treatment and emergency trauma care. Our facility is the only veterinary hospital in Kentucky that is always open and fully staffed for emergencies, as well as routine care, any time of the day or night.
